questions: Are the cars within each set initially equally spaced or arbitrarily positioned, as long as they are all to the left (for left-to-right) or right (for right-to-left) of the other set?
Do cars moving in the same direction ever collide or interact, or are they assumed to never overtake each other?
Is the speed exactly the same for all cars, and if so, is it constant and uniform throughout?
Does 'ongoing collisions' refer to the total number of collision events that ever occur, or the number of collisions happening at a specific moment in time?
Are the cars considered point objects, or do they have non-zero length that could cause multiple simultaneous collisions if they are long?
Is the road one-dimensional, and do cars occupy the same point exactly when colliding, or is there a tolerance range?
Should the function return the number of collisions as an integer, and is n guaranteed to be non-negative?
Does 'very far from each other' imply that initially no left-to-right car is to the right of any right-to-left car, and is that ordering maintained over time?
